primary_sources.title: In vitro reconstitution of the Escherichia coli 70S ribosome with a full set of recombinant ribosomal proteins
primary_sources.operation: Native 5S/23S plus 33 recombinant proteins; physical two-step assembly; sfGFP synthesis and integration with 21-protein R-iSAT
primary_sources.boundary: Native LSU RNA remains. Full-length output does not identify active fraction, fidelity or useful lifetime.

primary_sources.title: In vitro reconstitution of functional small ribosomal subunit assembly for comprehensive analysis of ribosomal elements in E. coli
primary_sources.operation: R-iSAT with transcript 16S and recombinant proteins in PURE
primary_sources.boundary: Native 50S supplied in original study; component synthesis timing matters.

primary_sources.title: Single-step in vitro reconstitution of the Escherichia coli ribosome mediated by two GTPase factors, EngA and ObgE
primary_sources.operation: Near-physiological assembly, integrated translation, EDTA-disrupted particle recovery
primary_sources.boundary: Native RNA and native TP70 containing biogenesis factors; no necessity/sufficiency proof of two-factor closure; transcript23S route unearned.

primary_sources.title: Autonomous ribosome biogenesis in vitro
primary_sources.operation: Active nascent SSU and LSU made from genes in S150 extract, differentiated by orthogonal/antibiotic reporters
primary_sources.boundary: S150 soluble proteome and starter ribosomes supplied; not a purified-component closure.

primary_sources.title: Autonomous Biogenesis of Early and Late Assembly Intermediates of a Large Ribosomal Subunit in a Minimal System
primary_sources.operation: DNA-brush cosynthesis of all33 LSU proteins and2 rRNAs; six factor genes support later binding intermediates
primary_sources.boundary: Intermediate binding endpoints; complete functional LSU regeneration not demonstrated.

primary_sources.title: Reconstitution of Functionally Active Thermus aquaticus Large Ribosomal Subunits with in Vitro-Transcribed rRNA
primary_sources.operation: Unmodified23S/5S transcript assembly;22% native peptidyl-transferase and30% poly(U) activity
primary_sources.boundary: Native-derived proteins and restricted endpoints; not full heterogeneous protein translation from an all-recombinant set.

primary_sources.title: Reconstitution of functional 50S ribosomes from in vitro transcripts of Bacillus stearothermophilus 23S rRNA
primary_sources.operation: Transcript23S supports peptidyl-transferase,3-4-fold below natural RNA
primary_sources.boundary: Not a demonstration of complete translation service with synthetic RNA and recombinant proteins.

primary_sources.title: Osmolytes stimulate the reconstitution of functional 50S ribosomes from in vitro transcripts of Escherichia coli 23S rRNA
primary_sources.operation: TMAO and telithromycin improve transcript-based assembly up to100-fold
primary_sources.boundary: Starting deficit roughly10000-fold; fragment assay, not full translation with ligand removal.

primary_sources.title: Translational impacts of enzymes that modify ribosomal RNA around the peptidyl transferase centre
primary_sources.operation: Continuous five-KO native-derived rRNA reconstituted with crossed TP50 sources; threefold fragment-activity loss tracks RNA
primary_sources.boundary: Much smaller than old fragmented-hybrid loss; remaining modifications present. Fragment assay cannot establish full function.

primary_sources.title: 23S rRNA modifications stimulate catalytic activity and prevent the formation of alternative structures
primary_sources.operation: Structural and kinetic measurements of ribosomes missing11 or12 PTC-region modifications
primary_sources.boundary: Alternative PTC conformations, lower thermal stability,2-3-fold slower peptide formation; cellular assembly, not purified transcript reconstitution.

primary_sources.title: Base methylations in the double-stranded RNA by a fused methyltransferase bearing unwinding activity
primary_sources.operation: Purified RlmKL modifies naked RNA and unwinds H74 transcript duplex; m7G2069/m2G2445 editing
primary_sources.boundary: Mature50S not a substrate; full synthetic23S assembly not established by the local operation.

primary_sources.title: Single methylation of 23S rRNA triggers late steps of 50S ribosomal subunit assembly
primary_sources.operation: RlmE-mediated U2552 methylation promotes45S maturation and70S association
primary_sources.boundary: Isolated precursor rescue requires crude-ribosome wash fraction; about25% conversion;70S association is not full protein-synthesis proof.

primary_sources.title: Ribosomal RNA modification enzymes stimulate large ribosome subunit assembly in E. coli
primary_sources.operation: RlmB and catalytically inactive variants aid assembly in modification-poor strains; selective chaperoning roles
primary_sources.boundary: Cellular mechanism, not sufficiency of a purified enzyme cocktail.

primary_sources.title: Methyltransferase RsmB chaperones E. coli ribosome assembly by orchestrating the recruitment of ribosomal proteins
primary_sources.operation: RsmB restructures16S3-prime domain; facilitatesS7 while delayingS19; modification cycle and salt-switch release measured
primary_sources.boundary: Local RNP operation, not complete30S active-yield/fidelity/lifetime evidence.
